The third pass

Round #3

This round puts the two earlier answers together. The drawing is concept 11 from round one, Primary Refresh, with the bunny on the left, the giraffe on the right and the elephant raised above the name. The colors are the twelve palettes from round two. Each animal wears the color it had in round two, and the wordmark takes that palette’s gray. Nothing else about the drawing changes.

Where we are today

The mark you use now

The baseline again, for comparison. This is the logo on the site, the signage and the paperwork today, and every option below still has to beat it.

Primary Refresh

Flat silhouette · Bookend lockup · Round one, as shown
Composition

Your current structure, redrawn: bunny left, giraffe right, elephant raised above the name. The geometry is cleaned up, the animals are redrawn as smooth shapes, and the spacing is evened out.

What carries over

All of it. The silhouettes, the white eyes, the elephant’s ear line, the proportions and the two-line wordmark are identical in every option below.

What changes

Four fills: bunny, elephant, giraffe and wordmark. Each one comes straight from a round-two palette, at the exact value printed under it.
